objective_text: Examine the assessment and development of transversal, professional, and sociotechnical competencies in engineering education, including their measurement tools and pedagogical strategies.
key_themes: Transversal and Professional Competencies in Engineering Education

objective_text: Analyze the role of rubric-based and performance assessments in evaluating engineering competencies, with attention to expert judgment and inter-rater reliability.
Investigate the development and assessment of critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and design mindset in engineering students, including domain-specific and general approaches.
key_themes: Critical Thinking, Problem-Solving, Creativity, and Design Mindset in Engineering

objective_text: Explore the assessment and cultivation of research competencies and investigative skills in engineering students, focusing on tools and methods for evaluation.
key_themes: Research Competencies and Investigative Skills in Engineering Students

objective_text: Synthesize findings on the development, validation, and role of self-efficacy, attitudes, and engineering identity in shaping student outcomes and experiences.

Compare psychometric and analytical methods used to evaluate the reliability, validity, and structural properties of instruments assessing psychosocial and competency-related constructs in engineering education.
key_themes: Psychometric and Analytical Methods in Engineering Education Research

objective_text: Examine how transversal, professional, and sociotechnical competencies are influenced by or interact with psychosocial constructs such as self-efficacy and engineering identity.
key_themes: Transversal and Professional Competencies in Engineering Education; Self-Efficacy, Attitudes, and Engineering Identity

objective_text: Investigate the role of motivation and learning strategies in the development of engineering competencies and identity, including their assessment and impact.
key_themes: Motivation and Learning Strategies in Engineering Education

objective_text: Compare the psychometric properties (e.g., reliability, validity) of instruments used to assess self-efficacy, attitudes, engineering identity, and related psychosocial constructs.
key_themes: Self-Efficacy, Attitudes, and Engineering Identity; Psychometric and Analytical Methods in Engineering Education Research

objective_text: Analyze the use of rubric-based assessments in engineering education, including their design, inter-rater reliability, and effectiveness in evaluating competencies in practical or project-based settings.

Examine the application of analytical methods (e.g., mediation, correlation, factor analysis) in engineering education research to explore relationships between competencies, psychosocial constructs, and student outcomes.
key_themes: Psychometric and Analytical Methods in Engineering Education Research

objective_text: Evaluate the tools and approaches used to assess critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and design mindset in engineering students, including their domain-specific and general applications.
key_themes: Critical Thinking, Problem-Solving, Creativity, and Design Mindset in Engineering
